name: Rezan Has Museum
scope: The adapted C Block factory wing that houses the Rezan Has Museum at the Cibali tram-side approach in Istanbul. The model represents the street-visible historic host building and its museum entrance.
era: Standing adaptation of the Cibali Tobacco Factory as documented by Kadir Has University and the Rezan Has Museum.

originalReview.notes: The published CC0 original shows the dark red brick arch and rough masonry base in the museum gallery behind the collection object. It is a material and heritage-interior reference. The street elevation and roofline are derived from the native footprint and written architectural evidence.

review.method: Exact native CC0 confirmation and first-party exterior facts with map identity reconciliation
review.notes: Started with the exact public-domain and CC0 originals already published by Qualla. The only selected photograph shows a brick arch and masonry base inside the museum. It establishes masonry character at the museum level. The covered cistern is below the mapped exterior. The exterior is based on the native plan and first-party written restoration and architectural sources. Unrelated objects and imagery with ambiguous or attribution terms were excluded.
